Commentary.Commentary: Australia on the other hand, will be delighted with their work. They bowled disciplined lines and lengths and made Indians work hard for their runs. Nathan Lyon finished with five yet again while Cummins chipped in with three. They will aim to bat well and set up a good target for India. It should be a cracker of a game from hereon. Join us in a while for the second session.

India will know they could have done a lot better with the bat. Rahul, Pujara, Rahane, Jadeja all got starts but did not make a big score. Karun Nair had yet another poor game and the tail didn't wag much after the 96-run stand for the seventh wicket. The deck is offering something for bowlers who are ready to take the extra effort. A 32-run lead can be made handy if they take early wickets.

That ends another fighting session of Test cricket. India began well with a stand between Ravindra Jadeja and Wriddhiman Saha. Jadeja got to his fifty and it looked like India might get a handy lead but as it turned out, Cummins once again got the better of the tail as he snapped two quick wickets. Lyon was deservedly the man to take the final wicket, earning himself a five-wicket haul, as Australia restricted India to 332

Hello and welcome to the third day of the fourth Test between India and Australia. As it has been in the series, a topsy-turvy day for the hosts has brought the game back in balance. Forgive me for the cliched statement, but the first session is the most crucial and could well decide the fate of the decider. While the home side will aim to surpass visitors' total, the Australian bowlers must be vying to bundle out India as soon as possible to hand their side some kind of a lead. Will the Indian lower order manage to tackle the fiery pace of Pat Cummins and accuracy of Josh Hazlewood with the new ball? Stay with us to find out.
...DAY 3, SESSION 1...

The ball started taking more spin later in the day. While India must be licking their fingers after seeing that development but it won't mean anything if the home side fail to gain a good lead. A lead of around 50 runs might also work given the situation of the game and conditions on offer. Will they be able to do so? Or will Australia bundle them out very soon?  Join us on Day 3 at 0930 local time (0400 GMT) to find out. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

The Indian batsmen had to take more responsibility since they were playing with only five specialist batters. But they failed to do so. And the most disappointed among them must be Karun Nair, who has had a really poor series. Talking about others, the story was similar as it has been in the series. KL Rahul scored a fifty and then failed to convert it into a big one. Cheteshwar Pujara batted out time and frustrated the Aussies. But he fell prey to a sharp delivery from Lyon.

The talk was all about the Australian pacers, but very quietly Nathan Lyon decided to unleash an outstanding spell of off spin to help his side roar back into the game. He took four wickets in the last session to absolutely dismantle India's middle order and put them on the back foot in the series decider. He was well supported by Steve O'Keefe who kept things tight at the other end. India are still trailing by 52 runs and have four wickets in hand. The match is decently poised but Australia will feel that they have edged the hosts today, considering that the latter were 157/2 at one stage.

Drops it short outside off, comes in, Ashwin looks to punch but reacts well to keep it out as he was surprised by the turn on that one.
Flighted outside off, Ashwin defends it watchfully.
Lands it outside off, Ashwin comes forward and turns it towards the leg side.
Floats it outside off, Ashwin pushes it into covers.
Pushes it towards mid on from his crease.
FOUR! Dispatched! Full toss from Steve, Rahane gets low and slams it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Runs have come easily in the last few overs for India.
Flatter outside off, kept out by the batsman.
Sharp turn! Floats it on middle, turns away, Ashwin is opened up and gets it off the outer half towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Fetch that! Drops it outside off, short though and Ashwin makes most of it and cuts it hard to the point fence. He has ensured Australia do not get away with the bad balls.
Flatter on off, Ashwin goes back and defends it.
Lands it on leg, Rahane shapes to defend but the ball bounces more on him. It bounces off the pads and dies down on the wicket.
Fuller outside off, Ashwin clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off, clipped through mid on for a single.
Bowls it outside off, Rahane spots that it is going away and pads it away.
Goes round the wicket and floats it on off, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Lands it on off, spins in, Ashwin goes back and works it to backward square leg for a single.
Gets in line this time and defends it watchfully.
Lands it outside off, Rahane pads it away.
Rahane comes forward and pushes it into covers.

NOT OUT! Flatter outside off, Rahane pads it away. The fielders think that is out and appeal long and hard. The umpire stays put. Smith and Wade are confident and go for the review - the first one of the game. Replays show it was way outside off and was missing the stumps. Rahane survives and Australia lose a review!
Rahane has left one and is rapped on the pads. Smith goes for the review. First one of the game!
Floats it outside off, spins away late and beats Rahane who comes forward to defend but is beaten.
Shorter outside off, Ashwin cuts it past point and takes a single.
Drinks!
Fuller and on leg, Rahane strides forward to bury it.
Comes around the wicket. Short and around leg, blocked.
FOUR! Shorter delivery and outside off, Rahane moves in his crease a touch and cuts it gloriously through point to score the second boundary of the over.
FOUR! Positive intent from India, says Ravi Shastri on air. Rahane dances down the track and whacks this fullish delivery towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short, quicker and around off, Rahane pushes it towards the off side.
Floats this one around off, Rahane buries it.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Ashwin pushes this tossed up delivery towards covers.
Ashwin dances down the track and pushes it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. Shortish and around off, Ashwin goes on the back foot and punches it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Second boundary for Ashwin. Marginally short and outside off, Ashwin cuts it to third man for a boundary. Brilliantly timed.
Steve O'Keefe is back into the attack.
Tossed up around off, Ashwin blocks it.
Slower through the air and around block.
Comes down the track and drives it to mid off.
Rahane uses his feet and blocks this tossed up delivery.
Rahane has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Lyon goes up for LBW against Rahane, turned down. Pitched up outside off, Rahane looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Australia appeal but the umpire is not interested. Think the impact was outside off. Lyon asks umpire and he conveys the same to him.
Short and outside off, stonewalls it.
FOUR! Right then, Ashwin is in the mood. Josh bangs this short, Ashwin swivels across and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Fullish again and around off, Ashwin drives it towards mid off.
Fuller and on the sticks, Ravi pushes it towards the off side.
Short and around leg, Ashwin pulls it to fine leg for a brace.
On a length, outside off, Ashwin drives it towards off side. But his counterpart, Lyon, jumps and stops it with one hand. Smith applauds his effort from the slip cordon.
Short of a length delivery, around middle, Ashwin blocks it.
Short and around leg, Ashwin tucks it in front of square for one run.
Looped up delivery, outside off, blocked.
Short and outside off, Ashwin is rock solid in defense.
Floated delivery, outside off, Ash strides forward to defend, but the ball takes the inside edge, brushes his pads and goes towards the leg side.
Ashwin works this towards the leg side again.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Ashwin nudges it towards the leg side.
Length and around off, Rahane stonewalls it.
Marginally ahead of a length and around off, Ravi clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length delivery, around off, Ashwin rocks back to block.
Fuller and outside off, Ashwin drives it towards covers where Shaun Marsh makes a fine save.
Sprays this around leg, Ashwin looks to flick but gets rapped on the pads. A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Full and outside off, Ashwin leaves it alone.
Josh Hazlewood is back on.
Faster and outside off, Rahane leaves it alone. Maiden over!
Tossed up around off, Rahane buries it.
Quicker and flatter, bunted back to the bowler.
Bowls it slower through the air and in the fourth stump line, blocked.
Floated delivery, around off, Rahane defends it.
Tossed up around off, Rahane knocks it towards mid off.
Ashwin drives this fullish delivery to point.
Fullish delivery around off, Ashwin opens the face of point and he drives it towards point, where Lyon dives to his right to stop it.
Bangs this short and around leg, Ashwin allows Wade to collect it.
Full again and outside, this time Ashwin drills it through covers for a couple.
Full and outside off, Ashwin looks to drive it with no foot movement and gets beaten.
Bouncer and down the leg side, Ashwin ducks under it.
Shortish and spinning, Rahane blocks it.
FOUR! Short and coming in, Rahane tickles it fine as the ball stays slightly low towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Floats this one around off, Rahane dead-bats it.
Flatter and outside off, Rahane decides to let it through.
Bowls this outside off, left alone.
Tossed up around off, defended well.
Short of a length delivery, pushed towards point.
Shaun Marsh comes under the helmet at short leg.
Full and on the sticks, Rahane drives it to deep point for a single.
On a length and outside off, Rahane shoulders his arms.

FOUR! Edged, but over the slip cordon. On a length and outside off, Rahane goes for a half-hearted cut and edges. But luckily for him the ball flies over the slip cordon and races away for a boundary.
Short delivery, outside off, Rahane has decided to leave it alone.
On a length, and outside off, Rahane leaves it alone. This time around the ball jumps up after Rahane leaves it and Wade adjusts well to gather it.
Floats this one around off, Ash leans forward to defend it.
Tosses this one around off, blocked.
R Ashwin is the new man in.

OUT! Second wicket after Tea. India in huge trouble! Shortish delivery which is spinning in, Nair rocks back eyeing to nudge it away but only manages to glove it. The ball goes onto the brush his pad and lobs towards the short leg region. Handscomb looked to catch it, but Wade goes ahead and grabs it. The tide has turned and all of a sudden Australia are way ahead in the game. India are 133 runs behind.
Goes over the wicket. Short and faster, Rahane pushes it very late towards point for a single.
Full and on the off pole, Rahane buries it.
Bowls it around leg, Rahane defends it towards the FSL.
Back of a length delivery, around off, watchfully defended.
Marginally ahead of length, swinging in, Karun shoulders his arms.
Fuller and angling in, Nair pushes this towards covers.
Loose shot from Karun Nair! Very full and outside off, Karun tries to drive it away from the body and misses.
Bangs this short and way outside off, Karun ignores it.
Full and on the stumps, Karun knocks it towards the bowler, who stops it in his followthrough.
Short and around leg, Karun Nair nudges it in front of square for a single.
Nair flicks this fullish delivery to mid on.
Flatter and outside off, buries it into the ground.
Back over the wicket. Tosses this one around off, Karun has blocked it cleanly.
Shortish again and around leg, tucked away through backward square leg for one run.
Goes around the wicket and bowls it short and outside off, Rahane pushes it towards point.

FOUR! Gets off the mark with an outside edge. Good length delivery, angling in, Karun looks to defend it close to his body but the ball takes the outside edge and goes between gully and third slip for a boundary.
Bangs this short and outside off, left alone.
On a length around off, Karun leaves it alone. The ball dips a bit as Wade tried to gather it and he was hit on the fingers of his right hand. Looks fine though and is affording a smile.
Shortish delivery, outside off, tapped towards point.
Full and around off, Karun drives it towards mid off.
Short of a length delivery, outside off, Rahane punches it through covers for three runs.
Pat Cummins to steam in from the other end.
Karun Nair is the new man in for India.

OUT! Huge wicket for the Australians and a brilliant start to the session. Lyon tosses this outside off, Pujara goes forward to defend but the ball takes the inside edge, kisses the pads and lobs towards Handscomb at short leg. He dives to his left to grab it. Lyon appeals and the finger goes up. Pujara knows he nicked it and starts walking. India will again have to be patient now and build another partnership. They trail by 143 runs.
FOUR! First runs of the session. Shorter delivery and around leg, all Pujara had to do was get his bat to it. And he does. The ball rolls away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Short and spinning in, Pujara works it around towards the leg side.
Full and on the sticks, blocked.
Pujara comes down the track and clips this tossed up delivery to mid on.
Bowls it outside off, Pujara comes down and hits it back to the bowler, who goes to his right and stops it.
The players are back out in the middle. Ajinkya Rahane and Cheteshwar Pujara are out to bat. Nathan Lyon to start the proceedings after Tea. Here we go...
Day 2... Session 3...

Yet another fighting session of Test cricket! India began well with KL Rahul playing his shots getting to his fifty. It was the spell from Pat Cummins that went in favour of the visitors. KL Rahul lost his head and threw his wicket away. Rahane too started very nervously but has settled down. Australians have not given away easy runs and will be hoping to do more of the same and take a few more wickets. The deficit is 147 runs for the hosts and will want to eat into it as much as possible before the second new ball. It promises to be another grind, join us in a while for it.
Floated delivery, outside off, driven to covers. That will be Tea, Day 2!
Tosses this one on off, Rahane stonewalls it.
Full and around off, Rahane pushes it towards covers.
Floats this on the sticks, Rahane buries it onto the pitch.
Bowls this outside off, left alone.
Tossed up around off, blocked.
Floats this one around off, Che leans forward in defense.
Short and around leg, Rahane tucks it with soft hands through fine leg for a single.
Tosses this one on pads, Pujara clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Lyon, from around the wicket, bowls this around leg, whipped towards backward square leg.
Short and spinning, Pujara blocks it.
Tosses this one around off, Pujara uses his feet and clips it towards mid on.
Slides this on middle, Rahane dead-bats it.
Bowls this on the sticks, Rahane leans ahead and defends it.
Floats this one around off, Rahane drives it solidly to covers.
Short and around off, bunted back to the bowler.
Pujara uses his feet and drives this tossed up delivery through covers for a single.
Slides this around off, Pujara stonewalls it.
Flatter and outside off, Rahane strides forward to block but the ball first hits his pad and then he defends it.
Tosses this on the sticks, blocked.
Goes around the wicket, and bowls it marginally short and outside off, Rahane goes for the cut and misses.
Short again and spinning, Che tucks it through mid-wicket for a single. 150 comes up for India.
This shortish ball stays low, but Pujara does well to keep it out.
Short and outside off, Pujara defends it off the back foot.
Bowls this outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Take that! Tosses this around off, Rahane kneels and sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a boundary. Superb stroke.
Floats this around off, Rahane defends it carefully.
Full and on the sticks, blocked.
Bowls this outside off, Rahane drives it straight to covers.
Flights this outside off, Rahane lunges and buries it.
Gets ahead to this full delivery and blocks it.
Pujara goes back and punches this floated delivery towards covers.
Che nudges this towards the leg side.
15th Test fifty for Cheteshwar Pujara!

FOUR! Pujara breaks the shackles. It felt that like its been two days since India scored some runs. Lyon pitches this up, Che dances down the track and plays his trademark flick through mid-wicket for a boundary. Yet another fifty for him, vital for him to hang on more though.
Pujara works this floated delivery towards the FSL.
Tosses this one around off, Pujara looks to defend but misses the ball hits his pads and goes towards the leg side. The FSL went to his right to catch it, wonder why.
Jinx goes forward and stonewalls it.
Tosses this one around off, Rahane lunges to defend but the cherry bounces more and takes the outside edge. The ball, however, goes past the silly point and lands safe.
Silly point in place now.
Loops this up around the fourth stump line, Rahane goes forward to defend.
Tossed up around off, Rahane leans forward to stonewall it.
Bowls this outside off, Rahane ignores it.
Floated outside off, defended carefully.
Jinx sweeps this full ball to fine leg for a single.
Flatter and shorter, Rahane goes back to defend.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Rahane pushes this floated delivery towards covers and wants a single. Pujara refuses it.
Tossed up around off, blocked.

Huge Lbw appeal, turned down. Lyon goes around the wicket and tosses it around leg, Rahane goes forward to block but plays the wrong line. The ball raps him on the pads, Lyon goes up but the umpire is unmoved. Think height was the factor, Wade thought the same and Australia opted against DRS.
Pujara blocks this looped up delivery.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Floats this on the sticks, Pujara looks to flick it away but it takes the leading edge and goes towards the bowler. However, the ball falls short.
Action replay of the last ball.
Bowls this outside off, Che gets his front foot forward and leaves it.
Tossed up around leg, Pujara tucks it towards leg side and looks for a single. Rahane refuses it.
Short and spinning in, Pujara camps back and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls the top spinner, it bounces more as Che looks to defend. But the ball hits his glove and falls back on the deck.
Short and outside off, Pujara goes back and punches it towards covers.
Floats this one again in the same area, Pujara buries it into the ground.
Flights this one around off, defended well.
Tossed up around off, Pujara blocks it.
Nathan Lyon returns for a bowl.
Floats this on the sticks, Rahane opens the face of the bat, strides forward and blocks it towards covers.
Tosses this one around off, bunted back to the bowler.
Sprays this around leg, Pujara nudges it through backward square leg for a single.
Full again, Pujara dead-bats it.
Full and on the sticks, buried into the ground.
Slides this around leg, Rahane goes back to leave it alone. But the ball hits his pads and rolls towards the short fine leg region. Leg bye taken.
Bowls this very full and on the sticks, Pujara drives it down the ground. But Cummins, at mid on, runs to his left, slides and stops it.
Short and down the leg side, Pujara ducks and Wade gathers it.
Marginally ahead of a length around leg, Pujara looks to flick but he misses. The ball raps his thigh pad and falls back on the pitch.
Fuller and outside off, left alone.
Length and angling in, Pujara stonewalls it.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Rahane blocks this floated delivery.
Rahane has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Chance? No, not edged. Flights this one outside off, Rahane looks to drive it but misses and Wade fails to gather it. He thinks there was an edge and dives to his right to collect it. But there wasn't.
Flatter and outside off pushed towards covers.
Tossed up delivery, around off, blocked.
Full and on the sticks, nudged to the leg side. Single taken.
Lands this full and around off, Rahane pushes this towards point.
Short of a length delivery, outside off, Che taps it behind point for a run.
Full and on the fifth stump line, Che offers no shot.
Good take from Wade! Josh bowls this down the leg side, Matthew dives to his left and gathers it sharply. Could've easily gone for four byes.
Fuller and outside off, Pujara has nothing to do with it.
Starts the spell with a length ball around leg, Pujara flicks it through backward square leg for a brace.
Time for a spell by Josh Hazlewood!
Jinx leaves this delivery which was bowled outside off.
Marginally short and outside off, enough for Pujara to cut it to point for a run.
Flights this one outside off, Che looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards second slip.
Floated delivery, outside off, buries it into the ground.
Full and on the sticks, defended towards the leg side.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, Rahane eases it to long off for a single.
On a length and fourth stump line, lets it through.
Bangs this short and in the line of the stumps, Che sways out of its way.
Lands this on a length and around off, Pujara stonewalls it.
Good length delivery, way outside off, Pujara leaves it alone and Wade collects it near his head. Good bounce there.
Marginally ahead of length and outside off, Pujara shoulders his arms.
FOUR! That shot had, 'Get out of my way,' written all over it. Pat pitches this full and on the sticks, Pujara stands in his crease and whips it gloriously through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Looped up delivery, outside off, driven towards covers.
Che uses his feet to this flighted delivery and clips it to mid on. One run added to the total.
Short and around leg, tucked away to fine leg for one run.
Tossed up outside off, Jinx pushes it towards the off side.
Floats this one around fourth stump line, shoulders his arms.
Tosses this one outside off, Rahane strides forward and lets it through.
Wade looks to be in some discomfort. He was wincing in pain in between overs.
Lands this full and outside off, Che sees it to to the keeper.
Short and around off, Rahane keeps the ball down with an angled bat and the ball goes towards fine leg. Run taken.
Short of a length delivery, Pujara pats it towards point for a single.
Fuller delivery, outside off, left alone.
Leg bye! Back of a length delivery, around off, Rahane looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball hits his thigh pad and lobs past the short leg fielder. Leg Bye taken.
Short ball around off, Rahane gets out of its way.
Time for some drinks.
Flatter outside off, pushed towards covers by Pujara.
Shorter outside off, punched back down the wicket.
Lands it outside off, Che comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Timing! Too full on middle and off, Pujara clips it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary for it. He was quick to get to the ball there.
Lands it outside off, defended watchfully.
Floats it outside off, Pujara defends it watchfully.
SIX! Top edged! Shorter in length outside off, Rahane goes for the pull once again. The ball lobs off the top edge and flies over the head of the keeper for a maximum. Crazy period of play!
FOUR! Now, that is unlike Rahane! Shorter in length outside off, Rahane expecting it, dispatches it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Risky shot to play but he gets off the mark with a sign of intent.
Shorter in length just around off, Rahane shapes to upper cut it but misses. There is a fine third man in place and that was a silly shot to play.
Good length just around off, Rahane defends it watchfully.
Indian skipper Ajinkya Rahane comes out in the middle.

OUT! Cummins has the last laugh! Shorter in length outside off, Rahul looks to pull it but is no position whatsoever. The ball goes off the toe end and lobs towards David Warner at mid off who takes it easily. The words have done the damage and Australia get a breakthrough. Rahul has once again, thrown away a start. The deficit for India is still 192 runs.
Third man is in place for KL Rahul.
Shorter ball around off, Rahul does well to ride the bounce, takes the bottom hand off and keeps it down. More words from Cummins.
Flatter down the leg side, Rahul shapes to paddle. He gets it towards fine leg for a single.
Short outside off, mistimed punch towards short extra cover.
KL opens himself up and drives it towards extra cover but does not find the gap.
Shorter outside off, Rahul shapes to punch but gets it off the toe end of the bat.
Full outside off, Rahul comes down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Rahul gets in line and defends it watchfully.

FOUR Leg Byes! Slants it on the pads, Pujara looks to tickle it fine but does not connect. The ball runs down off the thigh pad and into the fine leg fence. Leg Byes signaled. Good over for India, nine runs off it!
Good length outside off, Pujara defends it towards point.
Fuller length outside off, left alone.
Fended! Shorter in length on the stumps, Rahul fends it wide of short leg for a single. Cummins has a word with Rahul.
Fuller outside off, left alone.
FOUR! That's cracked! Shorter length outside off, Rahul does not miss out and crashes it through cover-point for a boundary.
Loopy on middle, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Flatter on the stumps, nudged down to fine leg for a single.
Rahul comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Lands it on the stumps, watchfully defended.
Lands it on middle, Rahul defends it.
Floats it on off, Rahul comes forward and defends it.
Outside off on a length, guided towards point by Pujara.
Just wide! Shorter around off, Rahul fends it wide of the fielder at short leg and takes a single.
Length ball outside off, Rahul defends it watchfully.
Rahul pushes it towards covers and looks for a single but is sent back.
Just short! Fuller outside off, driven on the up towards short extra cover. Lyon dives to right and makes a superb stop.
Does not carry! Good length outside off, Pujara has a tame push and gets an outside edge. The ball does not carry to Renshaw at first slip, he fumbles and allows a run.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Floats it outside off, Pujara comes down and drives it towards Cummins at mid off for a single. Maxwell tried stopping it from short extra cover but fails to do so.
Lands it outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
Shorter around off, Pujara goes back and cuts it towards point.
Fuller on middle, pushed through mid off for a single.
Cheteshwar comes forward and turns it through square leg for a single.
Pujara lunges forward and defends it.
Edged! Fuller in length on the stumps, Rahul looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards the second slip fielder.
Angles this one on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket. The timing is good and they get three runs.
On a good length, worked towards the on side.
Shorter length on the stumps, Che ducks under it.
Good length outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Good length just around off, Pujara defends it.
Short outside off, Rahul looks to cut but gets a bottom edge. The ball lobs towards the stumps but it falls short.
Comes forward and defends it.
Shorter on off, Rahul goes back and punches it towards covers.
Edged! Rahul is beaten in the air and gets an outside edge on his drive towards point.
KL Rahul brings up his 6th Test fifty.
Well played, KL Rahul! Lands it on the stumps, Rahul comes down and heaves it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Brings up his fifty but he will know he has to carry on and not spoil the good work.
Floats it on the stumps, Rahul defends it watchfully.
Shorter in length around the stumps, Rahul plays the controlled pull through backward square leg for a single.
Angles it on a fuller length, Rahul keeps it out from his crease.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Good length outside off, Rahul gets behind the line and defends it.
FOUR! Risky! Slants it outside off, Rahul arches back and looks to leave at first but then at the last moment, rams it over the gully fielder for a boundary.
Goes wide of the crease, angles it on the stumps, Rahul clips it towards mid on. Bird, the substitute dives and stops the ball. He is on the field for Shaun Marsh who has gone off.
Floats it outside off, Pujara defends it watchfully.
Rahul pushes it into covers for a single.
Gets behind the line and defends it watchfully.

SIX! Now that is a sign of intent! Floats it outside off, Rahul gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Superb shot, that. There was a brief chat between the two batsmen, might as well have been about scoring some runs against the spinners.
50-run stand comes up between KL Rahul and Cheteshwar Pujara.

Four Byes! What happened there? Floats it outside off, does not get up. Rahul looks to defend but is beaten. The ball goes through the legs of the keeper. Smith hares after it from first slip, dives near the ropes but cannot stop it. He also bumps into the advertising board. He needs to be careful with those dives. Byes signaled in the meanwhile by the umpire.
Flatter around off, defended back.
Length outside off, pushed towards point.
Fuller outside off, defended solidly by Pujara.
Shorter in length around off, Pujara arches back and gets out of the way.
Fuller in length just around off, Pujara defends it.
Length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Back of a length around off, Pujara rides the bounce and defends it watchfully.
Rahul comes down and pushes it back towards the bowler who goes to his right and stops the ball.
Flatter outside off, hit hard towards covers with a flat bat.
Defended watchfully towards point by Rahul.
Floats it around off, Rahul opens up and drives it to covers.
Full outside off, pushed into covers for a quick single.
Floats it outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Steve O'Keefe to bowl from the other end.
The physio is out in the middle, attending KL Rahul. Patrick Farhat used the magic spray and Rahul will continue.

That bounced! Shorter in length on the stumps, Rahul looks to ride the bounce and fends it towards short leg. He takes the bottom hand off but not before getting hit on it. He flinches his right hand in pain and looks to be in some trouble. He calls for the physio rightaway.
Hurls it outside off on a length outside off, Rahul defends it watchfully.
Full outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller outside off, Rahul does not miss out and drives it through covers for a boundary. That was asking to be hit and Rahul did just that.
Good length outside off, Rahul defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Fuller and wide outside off, left alone.

The players are back out in the middle. Cheteshwar Pujara and KL Rahul are out to bat. A lot depends on them for the hosts. Australia will aim to strike early and keep the runs down again. The visitors begin with Josh Hazlewood. Two slips in place for him. Here we go...
Day 2... Session 2...

An intriguing session of Test cricket! The Australian bowlers kept things right and will be satisfied with the wicket of Murali Vijay. India, on the other hand, will be happy with the way they have countered the swinging ball and will aim to get going post lunch. The pitch has played better and the hosts will want it to play same as they look to bat deep. The deficit for them is still 236 runs and Australia will fancy their chances if they keep taking wickets at regular intervals. Join us in a while for the second session of play.
Short and quicker, bounces a lot more but Pujara stonewalls it. That will be Lunch on Day 2.
Floated delivery around off, dead-bats it.
Short and around leg, Rahul nudges it through fine leg. Single taken.
Fuller and outside off, Rahul drives it to mid off.
Tosses this one around off, defended towards the FSL.
Full and on the sticks, bunted back towards the bowler.
Marginally short and outside off, Cheteshwar pushes it towards point and thinks there is a single. Rahul doesn't.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Bowls it slower through the air and around, defended.
Floated delivery around middle, flicked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Beautiful shot that, says Gavaskar on air. Flights this one outside off, Pujara dances down the track and creams it through covers for a boundary. The mid off fielder had no chance to stop it despite chasing it.
Quicker delivery around off, Che blocks.
Steve O'Keefe introduced into the attack at last!
Loops this one around middle, Pujara gets down the track and clips it in front of square for one run.
Tossed up around off, blocked.
Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
CP uses his feet and drives this to mid on.
Floated delivery around leg, Che defends it towards the leg side.
Tosses this one around off, Pujara blocks.

Snorter of a delivery! He's bowled 10 overs in the morning session but still bowls this kind of a delivery. Tells how much he has worked on his fitness. Pat hits the deck hard, 150kph, around off, Rahul looks to defend but realises the pace is too much and sways out of it. He got caught in a similar manner at Ranchi.
Sprays this down the leg side, Pujara plays it fine, the ball hits his thigh pad and goes towards fine leg. Single taken.
Lands this on a length and way outside off, left alone.
A leg slip is in place.
Fuller and sixth stump line, CP leaves it alone.
Good length delivery, outside off, Che leaves it alone and Wade gathers it near his head.
Short of a length delivery, around leg, Pujara tickles it fine. Hazlewood hares across, slides and makes a good stop. Two runs taken.
Sprays this around leg, Pujara uses his feet and clips it through square leg for one run.
Tosses this one around off again, Rahul drives it to mid off for a single.
Goes around the wicket to Rahul and pitches this up around off, blocked.
Bowls this quick again and outside off, Pujara looks to block but it takes the outside edge and the ball rolls past first slip. One run taken.
Quicker and flatter, outside off, Pujara defends it off the outer half.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, Che buries it onto the ground.
Full and around off, Rahul offers a front foot defense.
Marginally ahead of a length, outside off, Rahul has nothing to do with it.
Back of a length delivery, Rahul gets on his back foot to block.
Bowls it full again and outside off, KL looks to defend but it goes off the inner half to the leg side.
Fuller and comes in, Rahul carefully leaves it alone.
Lands this on a length and swings it away, Rahul shoulders his arms.
Flatter and around leg, Pujara nudges it to the right of the FSL and looks for a single but is sent back.
Loops this one around off, Cheteshwar bunts it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Che pushes it towards cover-point.
Tosses this on around off, Pujara blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Floater delivery, outside off, Che blocks it towards the off side off the outer half.
Quicker and outside off, Pujara buries it.
Full and on the sticks, flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Overpitched on the sticks. Lokesh gets his bat down and punches it elegantly through mid on for a boundary. Outstanding stroke, that. 50 up for India!
Fuller again, it comes in, KL defends it with an angled bat towards mid-wicket.
Fullish and outside off, the ball stays low after Rahul decides to leave it.
Loose shot from Rahul! Pat pitches this up and outside off, Rahul looks to drive it without no foot movement whatsoever. The ball narrowly misses the outside edge.
Length delivery, outside off, Rahul allows Wade to collect the cherry.
Quicker one and outside off, Pujara looks to cut it but sees the pace and leaves it alone.
Loops this one outside off, Pujara blocks it.
Floated delivery around off, Che uses his feet and knocks it towards the bowler.
Short and spinning, Pujara nudges it towards backward square leg.
Che punches this towards the bowler.
Misfield! Tossed up delivery, around off, Pujara dances down the track and drives it towards Josh at mid off who fumbles and that allows India to take the second run.
Good length delivery, outside off, 149 kph, Rahul leaves it alone.
Fuller again and in the line of the stumps, blocked towards the bowler.
Full and on the off stump, Rahul drives it to mid on.
FOUR! Nicely put away. Short of a length delivery around leg, KL tickles it past the leg slip fielder for a boundary. Cheteshwar praises him after that shot and pats him on his back.
Well directed bouncer! Rahul gets out of its way.
Short of a length delivery around leg, Pujara nudges it with soft hands towards backward square leg for a single.
Shortish again and it turns in, Rahul punches it towards mid-wicket.
Lokesh has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Marginally short and outside off, Rahul cuts it very late towards short third man for a brace.
Short and spinning in, blocked.

FOUR! Catch is the call, but it lands safe. Lyon tosses this one outside off, Rahul kneels and sweeps it between deep fine leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary. It came off the top edge and fortunately for Rahul, it didn't cost him.
Che gets to the pitch of this tossed up delivery, drives it through mid on and runs one.
Marginally ahead of a length, around off, KL defends it from well within the crease.
Back of a length delivery, swinging away, Lokesh gets on his toes and blocks it.
Angles in a full delivery on pads, Rahul flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery, angling in, KL shoulders his arms.
Fuller and around middle, Pujara places the ball towards covers and sets off immediately. Single taken, good calling that from Che.
On a length and outside off, Cheteshwar carefully leaves it alone.
Change of ends for Pat Cummins.
Shorter and around off, Lokesh shuffles a bit and stonewalls it.
Tossed up in the line of the off stump, defended towards the leg side.
Flighted delivery, Rahul looks to flick but it comes off the outer half and goes to mid off.
Flatter and faster, Pujara pushes it towards the off side and sets off for a quick run.
Bowls it slower through the air and on the pads, Rahul nudges it through square leg for a single.
Floated, outside off, Rahul drives it firmly to covers.
Nathan Lyon is back on.
Shorter again and in the line of the stumps, well blocked.
Short delivery again, around leg, Pujara hops, gets the bottom hand off his bat and blocks it softly towards the FSL.
Fuller and swinging in, Che  offers a front foot defense.
Length ball, way outside off, left alone.
Bangs this short, Pujara ducks to leave it alone but the ball stays low and almost hits the batsman on the back.
On a length, around off, Che prods forward in defense.
Time for drinks.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rahul.
Well bowled, well played! Shorter in length, angling into Rahul, the batsman is watching it closely and sways out of the way in time to let it go through. Good cricket allround!
Back of a length outside off, Rahul defends it towards point with an angled face of the bat.
Fuller in length around off, played back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, bounces more, left alone by Rahul.
Fuller outside off, Pujara pushes it to covers and takes a quick single. Warner was the fielder.
Fuller and on the pads, clipped to long leg for a single.
On a back of a length just around off, Pujara defends it watchfully.
Some issue with the sightscreen.
Shorter in length just around off, Pujara is not tempted enough to play a shot and lets it go.
Full outside off, pushed into the covers.
Pitched up outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it.
On a length outside off, left alone by Pujara.
Shorter length outside off, Rahul gets out of the way in time.
Full outside off, KL presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Rahul comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Angles it on a length, Rahul defends it.
A leg slip has been deployed for KL Rahul.

FOUR! Dropped! Fuller length outside off, Rahul looks to defend it but gets an outside edge. Matt Renshaw at first slip cannot hold it and the ball flies through to the third man fence. That flew before Renshaw knew anything about it.
Slants it on a good length, Rahul lets it go through.
Pat Cummins returns for a burst.
Shorter in length but going down leg, Pujara ducks and lets it go over him.
Length outside off, left alone this time.

FOUR! Now that is the way to get off the mark! Josh overpitches it outside off, Pujara does not miss out and crashes it wide of mid off for a boundary. What a way to begin your innings, he really hit that one nicely.
Fuller in length around off, Pujara pushes it towards covers.
Ranchi's double centurion Cheteshwar Pujara strolls out in the middle.

OUT! Hazlewood wins the battle! Angles it on a good length outside off, Vijay pokes at it and gets an outside edge which flies through to Wade who accepts the catch. Hazlewood is delighted and has a word, Vijay responds too but he can't do much now that he is out. His poor run of form continues, despite the 82 in the previous game. Australia get the breakthrough they wanted.
Shorter in length outside off, Vijay sways out of the way.
Lands it wide outside off, KL Rahul defends it watchfully. A maiden from Lyon.
Fuller around off, driven to short extra cover.
Flatter outside off, Lokesh Rahul stays back and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Rahul clips it nicely towards mid on from his crease.
Rahul looks to clip it through but get a leading edge towards mid off.
Shorter outside off, Rahul looks to punch it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full on off, Vijay defends it back to the bowler, who has a word to say to the batsman. Vijay is only smiling.

Just short! Angles it on a length just around off, Vijay has a tame push at it and gets an outside edge. The ball dies down on Wade who goes to his right and collects it. That kept low, hitting the crack!
Fuller outside off, Vijay defends it off the inside edge towards square leg.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Vijay.
FOUR! Timing! Fuller outside off, Vijay is careful as he plays this one through covers for a majestic boundary. Some timing, that!
Fuller and wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
This time he clips it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it on middle, Vijay clips it towards mid-wicket again.
Vijay comes forward and turns it towards mid on.
Fuller on the stumps, Vijay defends it watchfully.
Slants it on the stumps, nudged towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Welcome to the attack, Mr. Lyon! Nathan floats it outside off, Rahul gets on top of it and unfurls a cover drive through covers for a boundary.
Nathan Lyon brought on to bowl. He may be called on to make use of the early moisture on the wicket. He will get good bounce too.
Fuller outside off, swings in a touch, but wide enough for a leave.
Shorter in length just around off, Vijay gets out of the way in time.
Outside off on a fuller length, left alone.
Full outside off, Vijay plays a half drive towards point and looks for a single but Rahul sends him back. Maxwell was too quick to get to the ball and that prevented the single.
Fuller in length just around off, Vijay defends it.
On a length around off, Vijay defends it back watchfully.
Good length outside off,  wide enough for Rahul to leave.
Fuller in length just around off, clipped to long leg for a single.
Shorter in length but going down leg, Vijay lets it go with a duck.
Good length outside off, Rahul taps it towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
The square leg has disappeared, deep fine leg in place.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rahul.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Rahul defends it watchfully.
There is a short leg in place now.
BEATEN! And again, Josh angles one on a fuller length around off, Vijay plays at it and is beaten all ends up. Top over from Josh!
Good length outside off, Vijay stands tall and defends it.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Vijay ducks under it.
Another clip towards mid-wicket by Vijay.
On a length just around off, Vijay defends it towards the leg side watchfully.

PEACH! Bowls it fuller around off, Vijay looks to clip it through the mid-wicket region but loses balance. The ball comes in, in the air but pitches and holds its line and just whizzes past the off stump. Vijay was opened up completely there. Lucky to be out there!
Back of a length outside off, Rahul raises his bat high and lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, bounces a lot more, Rahul gets out of the way in time. Wade leaps up to take it as the ball bounces a lot more.
Ouch! Bangs it shorter on the stumps, Rahul gets into an awkward position as he looks to fend it away, taking the bottom half off the bat. There was no short leg and that saved Rahul there.
Good length outside off, Rahul defends it towards point off his crease.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered by Rahul.
Fuller and angling on the stumps, Rahul clips it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! If the backdrop is something, this is equally pristine from Vijay! Fuller around off, Vijay comes forward a touch, presents the full face of the bat with an angle towards covers. The ball just touches the bat and races through the cover region for a boundary. Nobody moved, there! Early contender for the shot of the day!
Hurls it outside off on a good length, bounces more, Vijay shoulders his arms. That bounced more but Vijay left it well.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Vijay ducks under it rather awkwardly.
Full outside off, left alone.

JUST SHORT! Lands it outside off, on a fuller length, Vijay is early into his shot as the ball bounces a bit more. It almost carries to David Warner diving forward at wide mid off. Vijay reckons that swung in late.

Good effort, Lyon! Fuller in length just around off, Rahul clips it through mid-wicket. Lyon from mid-wicket hares after it and dives to keep the ball in play. Three runs taken as the umpire refers it upstairs to check if Lyon had touched the ropes. Replays show he was fine and they get three as run before.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
On a length just around off, Vijay defends it watchfully.
Fuller outside off, shapes in, but wide enough for Vijay to let it go.
Slants it outside off on a length, comes in with the angle but Vijay lets it go through.
Hurls it outside off on a length, left alone by Vijay.
Fuller and angling on the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single. Rahul too is off the mark!

Good length outside off, Vijay pushes it towards covers and calls Rahul through for a quick single. While Maxwell gets across towards covers, the batsmen had crossed for a run. He fumbled too but no harm done as Rahul refused the second.
Game time! Murali Vijay and KL Rahul are back out to bat. Pat Cummins to bowl the first over of the day. Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go....

Pitch Report - Sunil Gavaskar informs that it's been a very good pitch to bat on. Talks about a spot (on good length) which is a little different (has cracks), shows the areas from where Ravindra Jadeja and Kuldeeep Yadav extracted turn. Says that it will turn today as well and as the match progresses. Opines that it is vital for India to get through the morning session as the new ball will do something.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the fourth and final Test between India and Australia in Dharamsala. The hosts will be delighted with the work done yesterday, bowling out the visitors for 300. They will aim to bat long and look to get to parity first and then see how it goes. Australia will look to strike early and put pressure on the Indians. Promises to be an exciting day of cricket. Stay tuned for all the action.
Day 2... Session 1....

India will be delighted with their effort, they would want to take the game by the scruff of the neck tomorrow as conditions will be good for batting (expectedly). Australia will want to bank on the turn and bounce on offer to keep taking wickets and not let the hosts get away. It promises to be an exciting day of cricket. Join us for all the action on Day 2 tomorrow. Until then, it's goodbye and take care! Cheers!

Swing, pace, bounce, turn and runs - Dharamsala's introduction to Test cricket has seen it all. India end the happier side of the two as they managed to come back in the game after conceding as many as 131 runs in the first session and it looked like it could be a long day for them. Things though changed dramatically in the second session. Some superb bowling by Kuldeep Yadav saw him take 4/68. It was once again Steven Smith who was brilliant with the bat scoring a ton as the Indian bowlers struggled to keep him quiet. Warner was dropped on the very first ball - it seems to have happened ages ago and he chipped in with a fifty, so did Wade to take his team to a decent total. KL Rahul then saw off the solitary over to ensure there were no hiccups.
Slants it outside off on a fuller length, Rahul shoulders his arms to it. That will also be STUMPS, Day 1!
Last ball of the day coming up!
Full outside off, no shot offered by KL Rahul.
Almost! Lands it outside off on a good length, goes away at the last moment, Rahul shapes to play at first but pulls out of the shot in time to let it go through. That hit the crack!
Fuller in length again, Rahul is watchful as he defends it.
Pitched up outside off, Rahul presses forward and defends it towards point.
Fuller outside off, swinging away, left alone by KL Rahul. Josh is happy with the carry and why not!
